# Introduction

Blobs are aggressive creatures found in the Swamps. They are large, gelatinous piles of sentient ooze that emit poisonous green gasses.

### Drops

• Item: Blob trophy | 0 Star: 10%

• Item: Ooze | 0 Star: 1

### Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in the Swamps | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Uncommon | Stars: No

• Type: Common spawn point in Sunken Crypts | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: No

• Type: Upon Oozers death, 2 spawn | Limit: - | Frequency: - | Stars: No

• Type: Spawned by Bonemass (4 per ability) | Limit: 8 | Frequency: - | Stars: No

• Type: During "A foul smell from the swamp" event after defeating Bonemass | Limit: 5 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

• Type: When a Blob bomb Poison is used | Limit: - | Frequency: - | Stars: No

### Area of effect

Blobs will stretch slightly before compressing and releasing a cloud of poisonous gas 4 meters in radius, applying the Poison status (90 Poison damage). Despite visual appearances, the cloud does not actually persist and only hits once. This ability can be used when a player is within 2 meters, and it has a cooldown of 2 seconds.

## Notes

• Blobs can follow players out to the ocean and jump into boats.
• Entering a Sunken Crypt and leaving Blobs alive there will count towards spawn caps effectively suppressing their spawns in a large area (including the Bonemass ability).
